items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: Paul Bob Riley. >> [INTERVIEWER] Yes, we know Paul, and we knew his father who died last year. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah, yeah, that's right.

ctx.x: No, Joe Phillips, no, not the kid in the end. No, no, no, no. Bob Riley's his brother-in-law. My brother-in-law is Bob Riley. Poor yes. Louis Bob Riley, the one that stayed across the street here. Poor yes. Paul Bob Riley.
Yes, we know Paul, and we knew his father who died last year.
